# **The Asian Giant Softshell Turtle: A Rare and Endangered Species**

The **Asian giant softshell turtle** (*Pelochelys cantorii*) is one of the world’s largest and most endangered freshwater turtles. Native to Southeast Asia, including Cambodia, Vietnam, Thailand, and parts of India and Bangladesh, this species is known for its massive size—some individuals reach up to **100 cm (39 inches) in length** and weigh over **100 kg (220 lbs)**. Unlike most turtles, it has a **soft, leathery shell** instead of a hard one, making it uniquely adapted to its aquatic environment.

This turtle spends most of its life buried in sand or mud near rivers, lakes, and estuaries, emerging only to breathe or hunt. It is an **ambush predator**, feeding on fish, crustaceans, and even small waterbirds. Unfortunately, the Asian giant softshell turtle faces **severe threats** from habitat destruction, pollution, hunting for meat, and the illegal pet trade. Conservation efforts, such as captive breeding programs in Cambodia’s **Mekong Turtle Conservation Center**, aim to protect remaining populations.

One of the most famous individuals was a turtle named **"Hope"** in Vietnam’s Hoan Kiem Lake, believed to be a sacred symbol. Sadly, Hope died in 2016, leaving only a few known individuals in the wild. Scientists continue to study this elusive species to better understand its behavior and ecology.

![Asian Giant Softshell Turtle in water](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/4e/Pelochelys_cantorii_1.jpg/800px-Pelochelys_cantorii_1.jpg)
*An Asian giant softshell turtle in its natural habitat.*

![Close-up of the turtle's head](https://www.edgeofexistence.org/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Asian-Giant-Softshell-Turtle-Pelochelys-cantorii-Cambodia-Turtle-Survival-Alliance.jpg)
*The turtle’s distinctive snorkel-like nose allows it to breathe while submerged.*

### **Bibliography**

1. **Asian Turtle Program.** “Asian Giant Softshell Turtle (*Pelochelys cantorii*).” *Asian Turtle Program*, 2020, www.asianturtleprogram.org/species/Pelochelys_cantorii.
2. **Platt, John R.** “Rare Giant Turtle Found in Cambodia—One of Only Four Known in the World.” *Scientific American*, 15 Oct. 2019, www.scientificamerican.com/article/rare-giant-turtle-found-in-cambodia-one-of-only-four-known-in-the-world/.
3. **Turtle Survival Alliance.** “Asian Giant Softshell Turtle.” *Turtle Survival Alliance*, 2021, www.turtlesurvival.org/asian-giant-softshell-turtle/.

With fewer than **10 individuals** believed to remain in the wild, urgent conservation action is needed to prevent the extinction of this remarkable species.
